newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up, but unrest mars mood.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up, but unrest mars mood.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Monday on squaring of positions on clearing day, but political unrest kept sentiment mixed, dealers said.

They said rumours of foreign buying prompted individuals to cover short positions, but the overall mood was clouded by reports of more clashes between police and Islamic militant demonstrators in Islamabad and nearby Rawalpindi.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 14.61 points, or 1.03 percent, to close at 1,433.34. Losers led gainers 110 to 102.
Dewan Salman Fibre rose 1.05 rupees to 28.65 and Fauji Fertilizer 2.40 up at 77.90. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
